metadata.name: chainbills
metadata.description: Cross-chain Crypto Payment Gateway powered by Wormhole + Circle CCTP

instructions.name: admin_sync_foreign_payable
docs: Admin escape hatch: apply a PayablePayload without a VAA.
Used when no common protocol exists between two chains.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The program owner. Must sign.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — validates owner.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — incremented when a new ForeignPayable is created.

accounts.name: foreign_payable
docs: ForeignPayable PDA for the given payable_id. Created if it doesn't exist.

instructions.name: allow_token
docs: Create or update a TokenConfig PDA marking a mint as allowed.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The program owner. Must sign.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — validates owner.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: The token mint to allow. Must be owned by a recognized token program.

accounts.name: token_config
docs: TokenConfig PDA for this mint. Created if it doesn't exist yet.

instructions.name: broadcast_payable_update
docs: Broadcast this payable's current state to all registered foreign chains.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The host or program owner calling the broadcast.

accounts.name: payable
docs: The payable to broadcast. Authority must be host or owner.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — provides has_wormhole/has_cctp flags and nonce counter.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — incremented on successful broadcasts.

instructions.name: close_payable
docs: Close a payable. Broadcasts close to all foreign chains.

instructions.name: create_payable
docs: Create a new payable (public invoice). Records PayableCreated activity.
Broadcasts PayablePayload to all registered foreign chains.

accounts.name: host
docs: The host creating the payable. Must sign. Pays for account rent.

accounts.name: user_record
docs: UserRecord for the host. Created if this is their first action.

accounts.name: payable
docs: The new Payable PDA. Seeded with host + host's current payables_count.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: Vault authority PDA. No data — pure PDA that owns vault ATAs for this payable.

accounts.name: config
docs: Program config — owner not needed here, but stats are split.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — counters incremented here.

accounts.name: activity_record
docs: Global activity record for this event.

accounts.name: user_activity_pointer
docs: User-scoped activity pointer.

accounts.name: payable_activity_pointer
docs: Payable-scoped activity pointer.

instructions.name: disallow_token
docs: Mark a previously allowed token as disallowed.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The program owner. Must sign.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — validates owner.

accounts.name: token_config
docs: The TokenConfig to update. Must already exist.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time initialization. Creates GlobalConfig. Only the program's
upgrade authority may call this.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The upgrade authority of the program. Must sign. Becomes the program owner.

accounts.name: program
docs: The program account itself — used to look up its programdata address.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's upgrade data account. Validates that `authority` is the
upgrade authority — the only entity that should be able to initialize.

accounts.name: config
docs: Admin config PDA. Seeds: [b"config"].

accounts.name: stats
docs: Chain statistics PDA. Seeds: [b"stats"].

accounts.name: sender_authority
docs: Sender authority PDA — keyless signer for CCTP deposit_for_burn CPIs.
Seeds: [b"sender_authority"].

instructions.name: pay
docs: Pay a local payable with an SPL Token or Token-2022 token.
If is_auto_withdraw is set, triggers immediate withdrawal.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — provides cb_chain_id for payment records.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — counters incremented here.

instructions.name: pay_foreign_via_cctp
docs: Cross-chain outbound payment (Solana → EVM). Burns USDC via CCTP,
publishes PaymentPayload via Wormhole shim.

accounts.name: foreign_payable
docs: The foreign payable to pay into. Must exist and not be closed.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — provides cb_chain_id (payer chain) and has_wormhole/has_cctp flags.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — counters incremented here.

accounts.name: chain_registry
docs: Destination chain registry — validates has_cctp and provides circle_domain.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint — the only token supported for cross-chain payments via CCTP.

accounts.name: payer_usdc_ata
docs: Payer's USDC ATA.

accounts.name: sender_authority
docs: SenderAuthority PDA — keyless signer that owns program_usdc_ata.
Authorizes the CCTP deposit_for_burn CPI.

accounts.name: program_usdc_ata
docs: Intermediate program ATA — holds USDC transiently before CCTP burn.
Authority: sender_authority PDA (signs the burn CPI).

instructions.name: pay_native
docs: Pay a local payable with native SOL.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — provides cb_chain_id.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — counters incremented here.

instructions.name: recv_payable_update_via_cctp
docs: EVM → Solana payable state sync via CCTP data message (no Wormhole).

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — incremented for received_cctp_update_messages and optionally total_foreign_payables.

instructions.name: recv_payable_update_via_wormhole
docs: EVM → Solana payable state sync via Wormhole VAA.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — incremented for consumed_wormhole_messages and optionally total_foreign_payables.

instructions.name: recv_payment_via_cctp_only
docs: EVM → Solana payment receipt via CCTP only (no Wormhole).

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — counters incremented here.

instructions.name: recv_payment_via_cctp_wormhole
docs: EVM → Solana payment receipt via Wormhole VAA + Circle CCTP.

accounts.name: consumed_vaa
docs: ConsumedVaa PDA — init fails on replay.

accounts.name: payment_nonce_pda
docs: PaymentNonce PDA — init fails on replay.

accounts.name: cctp_burn_nonce_pda
docs: CctpTokenBurnNonce PDA — init fails on replay.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — counters incremented here.

instructions.name: register_chain
docs: Register a foreign chain with its Wormhole and/or CCTP identifiers.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The program owner. Must sign and pays for the new ChainRegistry account.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — validates owner.

accounts.name: chain_registry
docs: ChainRegistry PDA for this foreign chain. Created here (init).

instructions.name: reopen_payable
docs: Reopen a previously closed payable. Broadcasts reopen to all foreign chains.

instructions.name: update_chain
docs: Update an existing ChainRegistry (add/change Wormhole or CCTP params).

accounts.name: owner
docs: The program owner. Must sign.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — validates owner.

accounts.name: chain_registry
docs: The ChainRegistry to update. Must already exist.

instructions.name: update_fee_settings
docs: Update global fee settings (fee_bps and fee_collector).

accounts.name: owner
docs: The program owner. Must sign.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — validated and mutated.

accounts.name: fee_collector
docs: The new fee collector wallet. Receives the fee portion on withdrawals.

instructions.name: update_payable_ataa
docs: Replace the payable's allowed tokens and amounts list. Reallocates
the Payable account if the new list is larger. Broadcasts update.

instructions.name: update_payable_auto_withdraw
docs: Flip the auto-withdraw flag. No cross-chain broadcast (local flag only).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw SPL Token or Token-2022 from a payable. 2% fee (capped per token).

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — provides fee_bps and fee_collector.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — counters incremented here.

instructions.name: withdraw_native
docs: Withdraw native SOL from a payable.

accounts.name: config
docs: Config — provides fee_bps and fee_collector.

accounts.name: stats
docs: Stats — counters incremented here.

errors.name: TokenAmountMismatch
errors.msg: Token or amount does not match payable's allowed list

errors.name: DuplicateTokenAndAmount
errors.msg: Duplicate token in allowed tokens and amounts

errors.name: InsufficientPaymentAmount
errors.msg: Payment amount is below the required minimum

errors.name: UnauthorizedHost
errors.msg: Unauthorized: signer is not the payable host

errors.name: UnauthorizedOwner
errors.msg: Unauthorized: signer is not the program owner

errors.name: StalePayableUpdateNonce
errors.msg: Stale payable update nonce — update already applied or out of order

errors.name: VaaAlreadyConsumed
errors.msg: VAA already consumed — replay protection triggered

errors.name: PaymentNonceAlreadyConsumed
errors.msg: Payment nonce already consumed — replay protection triggered

errors.name: UnauthorizedUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Unauthorized: signer is not the program upgrade authority

errors.name: MaxAtaaExceeded
errors.msg: Allowed tokens and amounts list exceeds maximum of 255 entries

errors.name: AtaaAmountZero
errors.msg: ATAA entry amount cannot be zero — use an empty ATAA list to accept any amount

errors.name: InvalidFeeSettings

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: ChainHasNoProtocol
errors.msg: Chain must support at least one of Wormhole or CCTP

types.name: ActivityRecord
docs: A single activity event in the global audit trail.
Globally indexed; pointer accounts provide per-entity access.
Seeds: `[ActivityRecord::SEED_PREFIX, ActivityRecord::GLOBAL_PREFIX, global_index.to_le_bytes()]`

fields.name: global_index
docs: The global sequence index of this event (0-based, monotonically increasing).

fields.name: activity_type
docs: The type of activity that occurred.

fields.name: entity
docs: The primary entity involved (payable PDA, user_payment PDA, etc.).

fields.name: actor
docs: The actor who triggered this activity (payer, host, relayer, etc.).

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp when this activity occurred.

types.name: ActivityType
docs: All possible activity types. Mirrors EVM's `ActivityType` enum.

types.name: CctpDataNonce
docs: Marks a Circle CCTP data-message nonce as consumed.
Created atomically with the state changes triggered by the data message.
A duplicate `init` fails → replay rejected.
Seeds: `[CctpDataNonce::SEED_PREFIX, circle_domain.to_le_bytes(), &nonce]`

fields.name: circle_domain
docs: Circle's uint32 domain ID of the source chain.

fields.name: nonce
docs: The 32-byte CCTP V2 nonce from the data message header (bytes 12-44).

fields.name: processed_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this data nonce was consumed.

types.name: CctpTokenBurnNonce
docs: Marks a Circle CCTP burn nonce as consumed on CCTP-only payment receive paths.
CCTP V2 uses a 32-byte nonce (bytes [12..44] of the message header).
The nonce is unique per source domain, preventing replay of the same burn message.
Seeds: `[CctpTokenBurnNonce::SEED_PREFIX, circle_domain.to_le_bytes(), &nonce]`

fields.name: circle_domain
docs: Circle's uint32 domain ID of the source chain.

fields.name: nonce
docs: The 32-byte CCTP V2 nonce from the source chain's burn message header (bytes 12-44).

fields.name: processed_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this burn nonce was consumed.

types.name: ChainRegistry
docs: Describes a foreign chain that Chainbills is deployed on.
Created by the owner via `register_chain`. Used for:
- Routing payable sync broadcasts (Wormhole vs CCTP path)
- Validating inbound VAA emitter addresses and CCTP source domains
- Cross-chain payment routing in `pay_foreign_via_cctp`
Seeds: `[ChainRegistry::SEED_PREFIX, cb_chain_id]`

fields.name: cb_chain_id
docs: The universal chain key: keccak256("namespace:reference") (CAIP-2).
e.g., keccak256("eip155:11155111") for Ethereum Sepolia.

fields.name: has_wormhole
docs: Whether this chain uses Wormhole for cross-chain messaging.

fields.name: wormhole_chain_id
docs: Wormhole's uint16 chain ID for this chain. Only valid if `has_wormhole = true`.
Used for VAA emitter_chain validation.

fields.name: has_cctp
docs: Whether this chain uses Circle CCTP for token bridging.

fields.name: circle_domain
docs: Circle's uint32 domain for this chain. Only valid if `has_cctp = true`.
Used in CCTP burn/receive message routing.

fields.name: registered_contract
docs: The 32-byte normalized address of the Chainbills contract on this chain.
For EVM: left-padded 20-byte address. For Solana: program PDA bytes.
Validated against VAA emitter_address and CCTP message sender fields.

types.name: ClosedPayable
docs: Emitted when a payable is closed by its host.

fields.name: payable
docs: The PDA address of the closed payable.

fields.name: host
docs: The host that closed it.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: Config
docs: Program-wide admin configuration. Created once by `initialize`. Never closed.
Mirrors the admin/config portion of EVM storage (owner, feeBps, feeCollector, etc.).
Counters live in `Stats` (`[b"stats"]`) to keep this account small and fast.
Seeds: `[Config::SEED_PREFIX]`

fields.name: owner
docs: The program owner. Can call admin instructions (allow_token, register_chain, etc.).

fields.name: fee_collector
docs: The fee collector wallet. Receives the fee portion on every withdrawal.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Withdrawal fee in basis points (200 = 2%). Max 10_000 (100%).

fields.name: cb_chain_id
docs: The cbChainId of this Solana deployment (mainnet or devnet).
Set at initialization. Used in cross-chain payload construction.

fields.name: payable_update_nonce_counter
docs: Monotonically increasing counter for payable update broadcast nonces.
Each broadcast increments this. Ordering cross-chain payable sync messages.

fields.name: has_wormhole
docs: Whether this Solana deployment supports Wormhole for outbound messages.
Mirrors EVM `hasWormhole()`. Gates Wormhole shim CPI in broadcast + outbound payment.

fields.name: has_cctp
docs: Whether this Solana deployment supports CCTP for outbound messages.
Mirrors EVM `hasCctp()`. Gates CCTP `send_message` / `deposit_for_burn` CPIs.

types.name: ConsumedVaa
docs: Marks a Wormhole VAA as consumed. Created atomically with the state changes
it triggers. If the account already exists, `init` fails → replay rejected.
This is the primary replay protection layer for all inbound Wormhole messages.
A secondary layer is the Core Bridge's own PostedVAA account, but we create
this PDA to store our own metadata and to survive Core Bridge account closure.
Seeds: `[ConsumedVaa::SEED_PREFIX, vaa_hash]`
where `vaa_hash` = the keccak256 hash of the VAA body (matches Core Bridge convention).

fields.name: vaa_hash
docs: The 32-byte keccak256 hash of the VAA body. Used as PDA seed.

fields.name: emitter_chain
docs: The Wormhole chain ID of the VAA's emitter.

fields.name: sequence
docs: The VAA's sequence number (from the emitter's emitter_sequence).

fields.name: payload_type
docs: The payload type byte (0x01 = PayablePayload, 0x02 = PaymentPayload).

fields.name: processed_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this VAA was processed by Chainbills.

types.name: CreatedPayable
docs: Emitted when a new payable is created.

fields.name: payable
docs: The PDA address of the newly created payable.

fields.name: host
docs: The host wallet that created the payable.

fields.name: host_count
docs: The host's payable creation index (host_count at time of creation).

fields.name: chain_count
docs: Global payable count at time of creation (snapshot).

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: ForeignPayable
docs: Represents the last-known state of a payable that lives on a foreign EVM chain.
Created and updated by `recv_payable_update_via_wormhole` and `recv_payable_update_via_cctp`.
The `payable_id` is the foreign chain's identifier for the payable
(on EVM this is a `bytes32` derived from `keccak256(...)` or the contract address).
Seeds: `[ForeignPayable::SEED_PREFIX, payable_id]`

fields.name: payable_id
docs: The foreign chain's identifier for this payable (32 bytes).
EVM: result of `keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...))` or similar.

fields.name: cb_chain_id
docs: cbChainId of the chain where this payable lives.

fields.name: is_closed
docs: Whether this payable is currently closed on its home chain.

fields.name: is_auto_withdraw
docs: Whether auto-withdraw is enabled on the foreign payable.

fields.name: payable_update_nonce
docs: The payable_update_nonce of the last applied PayablePayload.
New updates must have nonce > this value to prevent state regression.

fields.name: payments_count
docs: Total number of payments received by this foreign payable on Solana.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this ForeignPayable record was first created on Solana.

fields.name: allowed_tokens_and_amounts
docs: Allowed tokens and amounts from the foreign chain (Wormhole-normalized).

types.name: ForeignPaymentReceived
docs: Emitted when a cross-chain payment (EVM → Solana) is received and processed.

fields.name: payable_payment
docs: The PayablePayment PDA created for this inbound payment.

fields.name: payable
docs: The ForeignPayable that received the payment.

fields.name: payer
docs: Wormhole-normalized payer address on the source chain.

fields.name: payer_chain_id
docs: The cbChainId of the payer's chain.

fields.name: amount
docs: USDC amount credited (after CCTP fee deduction).

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: Payable
docs: A public invoice that anyone can pay into. Created by a host.
Size is dynamic: the account is reallocated when `allowed_tokens_and_amounts`
or `balances` vecs change size. Max 255 ATAA entries (wire format limit).
Seeds: `[Payable::SEED_PREFIX, host.key(), host_count.to_le_bytes()]`
where `host_count` is `user_record.payables_count` BEFORE incrementing
(this is the creation index, 0-based).

fields.name: host
docs: The wallet of the payable's creator and owner.

fields.name: host_count
docs: The value of `user_record.payables_count` at creation time.
Used as part of the PDA seed to give each host a unique per-index payable.

fields.name: chain_count
docs: Snapshot of `global_config.total_payables` at creation time.
Used by the relayer to order payables globally.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this payable was created.

fields.name: is_closed
docs: Whether new payments are rejected. Set by `close_payable`.

fields.name: is_auto_withdraw
docs: Whether each incoming payment should trigger an immediate withdrawal.

fields.name: payments_count
docs: Total number of payments ever received by this payable.

fields.name: withdrawals_count
docs: Total number of withdrawals ever performed from this payable.

fields.name: activities_count
docs: Total number of activity records linked to this payable.

fields.name: allowed_tokens_and_amounts
docs: List of (token, amount) pairs that this payable accepts.
Empty = accepts any token in any amount.
Max 255 entries (wire format uses 1-byte length field).

fields.name: balances
docs: Running balances per token in this payable's vault.
Each entry represents the total accumulated but not yet withdrawn for a token.

types.name: PayableActivityPointer
docs: Pointer linking a payable's nth activity to the global ActivityRecord.
Seeds: `[PayableActivityPointer::SEED_PREFIX, PayableActivityPointer::PAYABLE_PREFIX, payable.key(), payable_index.to_le_bytes()]`

fields.name: global_index
docs: Index into the global ActivityRecord sequence.

types.name: PayablePayment
docs: Immutable record of a payment from the payable's perspective.
Created in both same-chain and cross-chain inbound payment flows.
`payer` is stored as `[u8; 32]` (Wormhole-normalized) to support cross-chain payers:
- Solana payer: `pubkey.to_bytes()`
- EVM payer: `address.to_wormhole_format()` (left-padded 32 bytes)
Seeds: `[PayablePayment::SEED_PREFIX, payable.key(), payable.payments_count.to_le_bytes()]`
where `payments_count` is the value BEFORE incrementing (0-based index).

fields.name: payable
docs: The payable that received this payment.

fields.name: payer
docs: Wormhole-normalized payer address (32 bytes).
Solana: `pubkey.to_bytes()`. EVM: left-padded 20-byte address.

fields.name: payable_count
docs: This payment's index within the payable's payment history (0-based).

fields.name: chain_count
docs: Snapshot of `global_config.total_payable_payments` at time of payment.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The token mint credited. `system_program::ID` for native SOL.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount received in token base units.

fields.name: payer_chain_id
docs: cbChainId of the payer's chain.

fields.name: payer_payment_id
docs: The UserPayment PDA address on the payer's chain (or cross-chain payment ID).
Stored as bytes for cross-chain compatibility.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the payment.

types.name: PayableReceived
docs: Emitted when a local payable receives a payment.
For cross-chain inbound, `payer` is Wormhole-normalized (32 bytes) from the source chain.

fields.name: payment
docs: The PayablePayment PDA address.

fields.name: payable
docs: The payable that received the payment.

fields.name: payer
docs: Wormhole-normalized payer address (32 bytes — Pubkey on Solana, padded address on EVM).

fields.name: token
docs: The token mint credited to the payable vault.

fields.name: amount
docs: The payment amount in token base units.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: PayableUpdateBroadcasted
docs: Emitted when a payable's state is broadcast to foreign chains.

fields.name: payable
docs: The payable whose state was broadcast.

fields.name: nonce
docs: The nonce assigned to this broadcast (monotonically increasing).

fields.name: action_type
docs: The action type: 1=Create, 2=Close, 3=Reopen, 4=UpdateATAA.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: PaymentNonce
docs: Marks a cross-chain payment nonce as consumed.
Each EVM→Solana payment carries a payer-specific nonce in the PaymentPayload.
`init`-ing this PDA is the second layer of replay protection (first is ConsumedVaa).
Seeds: `[PaymentNonce::SEED_PREFIX, payer_chain_id, payer, nonce.to_le_bytes()]`

fields.name: payer_chain_id
docs: cbChainId of the payer's chain.

fields.name: payer
docs: Wormhole-normalized payer address (32 bytes).

fields.name: nonce
docs: The nonce value from the PaymentPayload.

fields.name: processed_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this nonce was consumed.

types.name: ReceivedPayableUpdate
docs: Emitted when a PayablePayload is received from a foreign chain and applied
to a ForeignPayable PDA.

fields.name: foreign_payable_id
docs: The payable_id from the payload (foreign chain's payable address as bytes32).

fields.name: src_cb_chain_id
docs: The cbChainId of the chain that sent this update.

fields.name: nonce
docs: The nonce of the update (used for ordering / replay protection).

fields.name: action_type
docs: The action type applied: 1=Create, 2=Close, 3=Reopen, 4=UpdateATAA.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: ReopenedPayable
docs: Emitted when a previously closed payable is reopened.

fields.name: payable
docs: The PDA address of the reopened payable.

fields.name: host
docs: The host that reopened it.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: SenderAuthority
docs: Keyless PDA that the program uses to sign CCTP `deposit_for_burn` calls.
Owns the intermediate `program_usdc_ata` token account. The PDA itself holds no
user funds — USDC passes through transiently and is burned atomically.
Seeds: `[SenderAuthority::SEED_PREFIX]`

types.name: Stats
docs: Chain-wide activity counters. Created once by `initialize`. Never closed.
Mirrors EVM's combined `ChainStats`, `WormholeStats`, and `CctpStats` storage variables.
Solana has no slot-layout upgrade concern (we use `realloc`), so all stats fit one PDA.
Seeds: `[Stats::SEED_PREFIX]`

fields.name: total_users
docs: Cumulative count of unique users ever initialized on this chain.

fields.name: total_payables
docs: Cumulative count of payables ever created on this chain.

fields.name: total_foreign_payables
docs: Cumulative count of foreign payable records ever created on this chain.

fields.name: total_user_payments
docs: Cumulative count of user-side payment records ever created on this chain.

fields.name: total_payable_payments
docs: Cumulative count of payable-side payment records ever created on this chain.

fields.name: total_withdrawals
docs: Cumulative count of withdrawals ever performed on this chain.

fields.name: total_activities
docs: Cumulative count of activity records ever created on this chain.

fields.name: published_wormhole_messages
docs: Total Wormhole messages published (payable updates + outbound payments).

fields.name: consumed_wormhole_messages
docs: Total Wormhole VAAs consumed (payable updates + inbound payments).

fields.name: emitted_cctp_payment_messages
docs: Total CCTP payment messages emitted via `pay_foreign_via_cctp`.

fields.name: emitted_cctp_update_messages
docs: Total CCTP payable-update `sendMessage` calls emitted via `broadcast_payable_update`.

fields.name: received_cctp_payment_messages
docs: Total CCTP payment messages received (burn + data message pairs).

fields.name: received_cctp_update_messages
docs: Total CCTP payable-update data messages received.

types.name: TokenAndAmount
docs: A (token_mint, amount) pair used in payable ATAA lists and balance tracking.
In ATAA lists: if amount > 0, payer must pay exactly this amount.
If the entire ATAA list is empty, the payable accepts any token in any amount.
In balance tracking: represents the total accumulated balance for a token.

fields.name: token
docs: The token mint pubkey. Use `system_program::ID` for native SOL.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount in token base units. Must be > 0 in ATAA entries.

types.name: TokenAndAmountForeign
docs: A (Wormhole-normalized token, amount) pair for foreign chain tokens.
Token is stored as 32-byte Wormhole format (left-padded for EVM addresses).

fields.name: token
docs: 32-byte Wormhole-normalized token address on the foreign chain.
EVM: left-padded 20-byte address. Solana: pubkey bytes.

fields.name: amount
docs: Required payment amount in token base units.

types.name: TokenConfig
docs: Configuration and cumulative stats for a token mint.
Created by `allow_token`, updated by payments and withdrawals.
Seeds: `[TokenConfig::SEED_PREFIX, mint.key()]`

fields.name: mint
docs: The token mint this config applies to. `system_program::ID` for native SOL.

fields.name: is_allowed
docs: Whether this token is currently accepted for payments.
Set to true by `allow_token`, false by `disallow_token`.

fields.name: max_withdrawal_fee
docs: Maximum fee cap in token base units.
Fee = min(amount * fee_bps / 10_000, max_withdrawal_fee).
Set by `allow_token`. Prevents runaway fees on high-value tokens.

fields.name: total_paid
docs: Cumulative amount of this token paid into all payables on this chain.

fields.name: total_received
docs: Cumulative amount of this token received (inbound cross-chain).

fields.name: total_withdrawn
docs: Cumulative amount of this token withdrawn by hosts.

fields.name: total_fees_collected
docs: Cumulative fees collected in this token.

types.name: UpdatedPayableAtaa
docs: Emitted when a payable's allowed tokens and amounts list is updated.

fields.name: payable
docs: The PDA address of the updated payable.

fields.name: host
docs: The host that performed the update.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: UpdatedPayableAutoWithdraw
docs: Emitted when a payable's auto-withdraw flag is toggled.

fields.name: payable
docs: The PDA address of the updated payable.

fields.name: host
docs: The host that performed the update.

fields.name: is_auto_withdraw
docs: The new value of the auto-withdraw flag.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: UserActivityPointer
docs: Pointer linking a user's nth activity to the global ActivityRecord.
Seeds: `[UserActivityPointer::SEED_PREFIX, UserActivityPointer::USER_PREFIX, user.key(), user_index.to_le_bytes()]`

fields.name: global_index
docs: Index into the global ActivityRecord sequence.

types.name: UserInitialized
docs: Emitted when a new UserRecord PDA is created for a wallet.

fields.name: user
docs: The wallet that was initialized.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp of initialization.

types.name: UserPaid
docs: Emitted when a same-chain payment is made to a payable.
Also emitted for cross-chain outbound (Solana → EVM) payments.

fields.name: payment
docs: The UserPayment PDA address.

fields.name: payer
docs: The payer's wallet address.

fields.name: payable
docs: The payable that was paid into.

fields.name: token
docs: The token mint used for payment (system_program::ID for native SOL).

fields.name: amount
docs: The payment amount in token base units.

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.

types.name: UserPayment
docs: Immutable record of a payment from the payer's perspective.
Created in both same-chain and cross-chain outbound payment flows.
Seeds: `[UserPayment::SEED_PREFIX, payer.key(), user_record.payments_count.to_le_bytes()]`
where `payments_count` is the value BEFORE incrementing (0-based index).

fields.name: payer
docs: The payer's wallet.

fields.name: payable
docs: The target payable. For same-chain: local Payable PDA.
For cross-chain outbound: the foreign payable_id as a Pubkey (bytes).

fields.name: payer_count
docs: This payment's index within the payer's payment history (0-based).

fields.name: chain_count
docs: Snapshot of `global_config.total_user_payments` at time of payment.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The token mint used. `system_program::ID` for native SOL.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount paid in token base units.

fields.name: payable_chain_id
docs: cbChainId of the chain where the payable lives.

fields.name: payer_chain_id
docs: cbChainId of the chain where the payer lives (this chain = Solana).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the payment.

types.name: UserRecord
docs: Tracks a user's activity counts and creation timestamp.
Created with `init_if_needed` on first action by a wallet.
Seeds: `[UserRecord::SEED_PREFIX, wallet.key()]`

fields.name: wallet
docs: The wallet this record belongs to.

fields.name: payables_count
docs: Number of payables this user has created. Used as the index seed
for new Payable PDAs: seeds = [b"payable", wallet, payables_count.to_le_bytes()].

fields.name: payments_count
docs: Number of payments this user has made. Used as the index seed
for new UserPayment PDAs.

fields.name: withdrawals_count
docs: Number of withdrawals this user has performed.

fields.name: activities_count
docs: Number of activity records linked to this user.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this UserRecord was first created.

types.name: Withdrawal
docs: Immutable record of a withdrawal by a payable host.
Seeds: `[Withdrawal::SEED_PREFIX, payable.key(), payable.withdrawals_count.to_le_bytes()]`
where `withdrawals_count` is the value BEFORE incrementing (0-based index).

fields.name: payable
docs: The payable that was withdrawn from.

fields.name: host
docs: The host wallet that performed the withdrawal.

fields.name: token_mint
docs: The token mint withdrawn. `system_program::ID` for native SOL.

fields.name: amount
docs: Gross withdrawal amount (before fee deduction).

fields.name: fees
docs: Fee deducted (min of percentage-based and max_fee cap).

fields.name: net_amount
docs: Net amount actually received by the host (amount - fees).

fields.name: withdrawal_count
docs: This withdrawal's index within the payable's withdrawal history (0-based).

fields.name: chain_count
docs: Snapshot of `global_config.total_withdrawals` at time of withdrawal.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the withdrawal.

types.name: Withdrew
docs: Emitted when a host withdraws funds from a payable.

fields.name: withdrawal
docs: The Withdrawal PDA address.

fields.name: payable
docs: The payable that was withdrawn from.

fields.name: host
docs: The host that performed the withdrawal.

fields.name: token
docs: The token mint withdrawn.

fields.name: amount
docs: Gross withdrawal amount (before fees).

fields.name: fees
docs: Fee amount deducted.

fields.name: net_amount
docs: Net amount received by host (amount - fees).

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix timestamp.
